# TinyRustLM

> TinyRustLM.MiRust.com is the TinyRustLM developer portal: a plain PHP project website explaining a zero-dependency Rust/WebAssembly browser-local small language model runtime, an absorbed legacy runtime documentation archive, custom .slm artifacts, strict validation, quantized execution, adapter sidecars, selector registries, deterministic test evidence, UAI file memory, durable reports, and a direct project contact route for Mike Kappel.

## Core Pages

- [Overview](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/): Project summary, constraints, runtime surfaces, and deployment posture.
- [Peer Companion Inventory](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/browser-runtime/): Generated local P2P share kits write and inspect metadata-only `minimodel.peer_companion_inventory.v0` files for consenting known-peer flows, binding companion state, receipt ledger, piece-store byte/quota evidence, contact cards, and a `ready-after-rust-reverify` serve plan without model bytes.
- [Inventory Import UI](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/browser-runtime/): TinyRustLM can load local peer companion inventory JSON in simple/advanced P2P panels, reject no-byte-boundary and serve-plan drift, and show Rust-reverify-required summary metadata with the peer status route without remote requests.
- [Architecture](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/architecture/): System map covering the static browser UI, Rust/WASM runtime, offline packer, local server, harness, and claim boundaries.
- [Runtime](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/runtime/): Rust/WASM runtime responsibilities, memory transfer, generation, diagnostics, and explicit error states.
- [.slm Format](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/slm-format/): Custom model artifact contract for header, tensor directory, tokenizer metadata, quantization fields, and checksum validation.
- [Quantization](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/quantization/): f32, q8_0, and q4_0 memory math under the 33,554,432-byte browser selector budget.
- [Browser Runtime](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/browser-runtime/): Local browser app behavior, TinyRustLM Chat mode at https://TinyRustLM.com/, honest first-run empty transcript and implemented composer controls only, real Model Setup sidebar actions for Local .slm/Hugging Face/P2P import/Advanced tools, local/Hugging Face/P2P source choices, Local Connect approval policy UI with app-category risk warnings, browser/email trust preset, endpoint policy JSON export, endpoint app-list risk/decision/action rows, `local-connect-approval-ui` coverage, `local-connect-endpoint-ui` mock loopback endpoint policy-download/health/category/apps/decision/action dry-run coverage, and `local-connect-rust-endpoint-ui` coverage against the real Rust endpoint process, Hugging Face P2P-on-by-default source list with availability summary buckets for P2P-ready, proof-ready-needs-peer, local-.slm-needed, external-.slm-review, and Rust-conversion-needed rows, shared simple/advanced source-row actions, safe `.safetensors` source-file hints for local conversion, `minimodel.huggingface_conversion_request.v0` plus self-contained local conversion script downloads that can recreate the request sidecar, one-command `convert-huggingface-request` local conversion receipt flow with MiniModel share-directory, `prepare-peer-share`, catalog snapshot, peer-source announcement/feed, local peer-serving, metadata-only publication hints, and public binary `huggingface_conversion_cli` coverage for deterministic single-file and sharded fixture conversion, reviewed file and shard-directory pass paths, SHA-drift fail-closed behavior, and unsafe request identifier/known-peer rejection, generated local `.minimodel-serve-peer-pieces.ps1` helpers that re-inspect companion state with `inspect-peer-companion-state` before preferring `serve-peer-companion` when state exists and support path-prefixed peer base URLs, `peer-source-announcements.v0.json`, feed-bound `models.with-announcement-feed.v0.json`, metadata-only `write-peer-companion-state` handoff JSON plus `inspect-peer-companion-state` validation and `write-peer-contact-card` URL handoff JSON with executed-kit smoke coverage, local peer contact card loading to set Known peer URL after no-project-server/Rust-reverify validation with root-package `hf-peer-contact-card-ui` smoke coverage plus fail-closed `hf-peer-contact-card-reject-ui` coverage, `converted-once-p2p-publish.README.txt`, `P2P Import` for MiniModel matches with complete peer-offer proof plus catalog peer source or Known peer URL, `Set Peer URL` fallback, one-command `prepare-peer-share` sender execution, `add-peer-source` for later consenting peer availability metadata, `write-peer-source-announcement` for portable availability metadata, `write-peer-source-announcement-feed` plus `inspect-peer-source-announcement-feed` for availability feed write/preflight, `write-catalog-snapshot-with-announcement-feed` for feed-bound snapshots, local peer-source announcement JSON overlay on loaded `models.v0.json`, same-origin SHA-256-bound catalog announcement feed routes with feed-envelope/no-project-server/duplicate model-peer/peer-offer route and chunk proof checks including valid empty feeds that do not make rows P2P-ready, `apply-peer-source-announcements` for maintainer drift checks, batch `write-catalog-snapshot-with-announcements` publication, metadata-only `write-catalog-snapshot` reuse, local `models.v0.json` loading before Hugging Face search, self-locating `check-peer-status`/preflight/`import-peer-request` receiver execution with peer-status and advertised companion-state validation plus final peer-transfer receipt evidence, local browser import/generation of peer-assembled `.slm` output, metadata-only share metadata plus share-kit-ready MiniModel P2P bundle export after verified `.slm` import with MiniModel `inspect-share-metadata` validation for bundle shape/chunk proof/no-live-transfer boundaries, `share-metadata-ui` coverage against the actual browser downloads, and source plus mapped public-root `share-metadata-import-ui` coverage proving local share metadata reimports as checksum-bound `Use Metadata` rows until generated catalog/manifest metadata exists, including chunk-list drift rejection, wrong local `.slm` rejection, matching local `.slm` generation, and no remote model/catalog requests, optional future user-run MiniModel Peer Companion for advanced local peer duties, selector registry routing, local-only imports, `local-import-ambiguous-selection` coverage for duplicate `.slm` or duplicate receipt rejection, live public smoke proof that only app/runtime assets load before user action, transcript state, and reset boundaries.
- Generated conversion/share kits run `inspect-peer-source-announcement-feed` immediately after writing `peer-source-announcements.v0.json`; feed-bound catalog snapshots are created only after that Rust preflight passes. They also run `inspect-catalog-snapshot` after writing normal and feed-bound `models.v0.json` snapshots, `inspect-peer-companion-state` after writing companion handoff state, and `inspect-peer-contact-book` after writing the contact-book handoff. Local share kits also write and inspect a local import receipt, sender-side `import-receipts.v0.json`, and peer companion inventory. Generated share kits honor `MINIMODEL_KNOWN_PEER_BASE_URL` for reviewed local automation, and source plus mapped public-root `share-metadata-kit-exec` executes the exact browser-downloaded `.minimodel-share-kit.ps1`, verifies MiniModel metadata plus local receipt, sender-side receipt-ledger, feed, catalog, companion-state validation PASS output, contact-card/contact-book outputs, and companion-inventory validation PASS output, starts local companion serving, and runs `check-peer-status` without fetching peer-piece or artifact bytes.
- Peer contact books are supported beside peer contact cards: TinyRustLM can load local `minimodel.peer_contact_book.v0` metadata, validate embedded card SHA-256s, duplicate peer rejection, and no-model-byte/no-peer-piece/no-catalog-claim boundaries, render all reviewed peers as a chooser, set Known peer URL from the selected reviewed peer, and `hf-peer-contact-book-ui` / `hf-peer-contact-book-reject-ui` prove accept/reject behavior. Generated conversion/share kits now write and inspect those books when `KnownPeerBaseUrl` is set.
- Generated P2P import scripts run MiniModel `inspect-peer-import-request` before `check-peer-status`, then `inspect-peer-status-check` before preflight, followed by saved-preflight inspection, import, `inspect-import-receipt`, `inspect-peer-import-receipt` with receipt-after-preflight timestamp ordering, `write-import-receipt-ledger`, `inspect-import-receipt-ledger`, and local `.slm` browser import.
- Known peer URLs must be direct `http://` peer URLs with plain DNS/IPv4 host text and safe absolute paths; query strings, fragments, traversal paths, whitespace/control paths, non-plain host text, canonical project/Hugging Face hosts, `www` aliases, subdomains, and trailing DNS-root-dot variants fail before TinyRustLM saves the URL or writes generated handoff scripts. The `peer-url-unsafe-ui` smoke proves this on source and mapped public-host roots.
- `inspect-gguf <input.gguf> [output.report]` is now a Rust source-packer intake gate: it streams GGUF metadata and tensor directories, validates supported GGML tensor encodings plus byte ranges, and writes checksum-bearing inspection evidence without yet converting GGUF payloads into `.slm`.
- Local Connect approvals expose `Ask every time`, `Always approve selected`, `Trust Browsers + Email`, and high-risk `Full local-control lab mode`; category warnings cover browsers, email apps, docs/office, files/folders, terminal/scripts, and passwords/payments/settings, approved app names stay in local storage, the browser renders a `tinyrustlm.local_connect_approval_policy.v0` JSON preview and can save `tinyrustlm-local-connect-policy.v0.json` without sending it to project servers, and Rust `tinyrustlm-local-connect` validates that policy and can run a loopback `serve-approval-endpoint` health/categories/apps/decision/action API. Endpoint identity is hash-bound with canonical policy SHA-256 in `policy_sha256`; `/v0/apps` uses bounded local app-name discovery plus common fallbacks, marks known rows as `Found locally`, exposes names/category/risk/decision only with `inventory_paths_exposed=false`, gives each row local controls to always approve the app, always approve its category, or block the category before saving a refreshed endpoint policy JSON, and recomputes visible row decisions when full local-control lab mode is selected while explicit blocks stay denied; and `/v0/action` requires the same digest in `x-tinyrustlm-policy-sha256`, dry-runs by default, and limits execution to typed native-opener actions.
- The local browser picker can select a peer-assembled `.slm` with its `.minimodel-receipt` sidecar; TinyRustLM validates receipt shape, strict UTC timestamp, model id, manifest/artifact SHA-256 values, artifact byte count, SLM shape/quantization/evidence fields, `import.next_gate`, peer path hints, peer base URL, companion-state URL/status, fixed chunk mode, final receiver-validation contract gates, peer-transfer evidence, companion metadata flag, and no-project-server-byte flags before rendering `minimodel-p2p-import-receipt` provenance. After Rust/WASM acceptance it surfaces receipt hash/time, sidecar name, manifest SHA-256, receiver-validation status, peer URL, companion status, chunk count, artifact SHA-256, and browser-load readiness in the Provenance panel. It accepts exactly one `.slm` and at most one receipt sidecar, rejecting ambiguous selections instead of guessing.
- Receipt-drift smoke mutates the sidecar artifact SHA-256, `peer_companion_state_metadata_fetched`, `receiver_validation.import_receipt_required_before_browser_load`, `receiver_validation_contract.status`, and `receipt.created_utc`, proving TinyRustLM reports the expected MiniModel receipt error before selecting the local model.
- Import receipt ledgers are browser metadata only: the simple P2P panel and Advanced source details load `minimodel.import_receipt_ledger.v0`, validate no-byte boundaries, counts, SHA-256 fields, duplicate receipt paths, peer-import gates, and direct peer URL shape, show `Rust reverify required`, and leave `minimodel inspect-import-receipt-ledger` as the local trust gate. Generated P2P import scripts write `import-receipts.v0.json` and inspect it before browser import.
- Peer status checks are browser metadata only: the simple P2P panel and Advanced source details load `minimodel.peer_status_check`, validate route/manifest/artifact/piece SHA-256 fields plus no-peer-piece/no-artifact-byte boundaries, show peer URL, piece count, companion route, report SHA-256, and `Rust reverify required`; generated receiver scripts revalidate saved reports with MiniModel `inspect-peer-status-check`, and `peer-status-check-ui` proves browser drift rejection without remote requests.
- The local `Peer-source announcement/feed JSON` picker accepts full `peer-source-announcements.v0.json` feed envelopes as well as single announcements; `hf-peer-announcement-ui` proves the feed file path applies a matching peer source before `P2P Import`, and MiniModel `inspect-peer-source-announcement-feed` covers the matching Rust preflight for existing feeds.
- Root-package public-host local import smoke proves TinyRustLM.com can import a real user-selected fixture `.slm`, verify SHA-256/provenance, run Rust/WASM generation, and reject duplicate `.slm` or duplicate receipt selections while loading only app/runtime assets from the project host.
- Root-package public-host share-kit smoke proves the packaged TinyRustLM.com root can save and execute the exact local P2P share kit, write and inspect a local import receipt plus sender-side receipt ledger, start local MiniModel companion serving only after both the printed serve hint and helper inspect companion state, and validate peer-status metadata without fetching peer-piece or artifact bytes.
- Root-package public-host share-metadata receiver smoke proves the packaged TinyRustLM.com root rejects chunk-list drift and wrong local `.slm` artifacts, keeps valid local share metadata at `Use Metadata`, loads/generates from the matching local `.slm`, and makes only app/runtime network requests.
- Root-package public-host P2P smoke proves the packaged TinyRustLM.com root can complete the `hf-p2p-import-kit-exec` converted-once-to-P2P path with catalog/manifest/feed metadata, a consenting path-prefixed MiniModel peer at `http://127.0.0.1:8123/peer-pieces/`, peer-status/status-check-inspection/preflight/preflight-inspection/import verification, receipt-chain inspection, generated receipt-ledger inspection, receipt-matched `.slm` output, local browser import, and Rust/WASM generation, and `hf-p2p-import-receipt-reject` proves receipt artifact SHA, companion metadata, receiver-validation gate, receiver-validation contract status, and timestamp drift fail closed.
- Peer URL, peer contact card/book, and P2P toggle refreshes preserve accepted Hugging Face `.safetensors` source metadata, so source-backed `Start Conversion` / `Review Conversion` fallbacks remain available after P2P handoffs.
- Source `hf-search-ui` coverage captures both Hugging Face conversion-kit branches: the normal single-file `Start Conversion` request/script/README and the large two-shard `Review Conversion` request/script/README with `source_input_mode=safetensors-shard-directory`, reviewed-directory guidance, and no Hugging Face `/resolve/` byte fetch.
- `convert-huggingface-request` preflight evidence records `request_sha256`, successful conversion receipts record `output_slm_sha256` plus `output_manifest_sha256`, and `inspect-huggingface-conversion-receipt` revalidates the request/preflight/receipt/manifest chain before MiniModel sharing.
- Source `hf-conversion-kit-exec` executes both generated conversion branches, including sharded `Review Conversion` against a reviewed deterministic shard directory with local shard hash/byte evidence, and verifies Rust `.slm` conversion plus MiniModel metadata outputs, including peer contact book inspection plus direct serve-hint and serve-helper companion-state inspection, without project-server model bytes.
- Source `hf-conversion-kit-exec` also executes the exact generated `Review Conversion` script against unreconciled mismatched shard metadata and proves Rust fails closed with `source_contract_status=fail`, no `.slm`, no receipt, and no MiniModel peer-share output.
- [Adapters](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/adapters/): ADP1, ASP1, and ALR1 adapter sidecars with Rust validation-before-apply.
- [Model Breeding](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/model-breeding/): Offline candidate lineage, parent compatibility, operator receipts, manifests, runtime-smoke, eval evidence, and selector admission.
- [Testing](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/testing/): Rust tests, browser harness checks, WASM ABI smoke, browser smoke modes, and performance soak.
- [Developer Portal](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/developer-portal/): Consolidated TinyRustLM implementation docs, legacy runtime archive, preserved checksum manifest, proof routes, operations notes, and current TinyRustLM.com app boundary.
- [Roadmap](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/roadmap/): Proof-first expansion plan and explicit future boundaries.
- [Glossary](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/glossary/): Definitions for .slm, q8_0, q4_0, ADP1, ASP1, ALR1, selector registry, and runtime-smoke.
- [Docs + UAI Memory](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/): Durable report archive, long-term memory body, report index, and .uai read order.
- [Contact Mike Kappel](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/contact/): Direct project contact route with email, phone, portfolio, contact hub, LinkedIn, GitHub, and NuGet links.

## Durable Memory

- [Long-term memory](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/long-term-memory.md): Durable project memory body for current scope, public claim boundaries, report routing, and next recursive direction.
- [Report index](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/report-index.md): Preserved report manifest with source filenames, roles, byte counts, and checksums.
- [Legacy runtime archive](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/runtime-portal/index.md): Current index for the runtime documentation corpus absorbed into this developer portal.
- [Runtime portal preservation manifest](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/runtime-portal/MANIFEST.md): Checksum-bearing manifest for the absorbed legacy runtime corpus.
- [Runtime implementation archive](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/runtime-portal/runtime-docs/implementation/index.md): Preserved implementation docs.
- [.uai index](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/.uai/index.uai): Agent file-memory read order.
- [.uai long-term pointer ledger](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/.uai/long-term-memory.uai): Pointer ledger deep-linking every report and durable memory target.

## Preserved Reports

- [Engineering Tiny Language Models for Deterministic WebAssembly and Rust Runtimes](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/tiny-language-models-for-wasm.md): Core tiny-model feasibility, micro-model tiers, quantization constraints, deterministic WASM smoke testing, and Rust/WASM runtime pressure.
- [Architecting Minimalist Neural Inference in WebAssembly](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/rust-wasm-neural-model-patterns.md): WASM heap planning, zero-copy tensor views, tokenizer data structures, SIMD matrix-vector kernels, and deterministic neural inference design.
- [Architecture and Engineering of TinyRustLM](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/understanding-tinyrustlm-creation-and-purpose.md): Primary TinyRustLM explanation: browser-local runtime, .slm format, q8/q4 quantization, adapters, selector registries, and offline model breeding.
- [Tiny Language Models for Rust/WASM](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/tiny-language-models-for-rust-wasm.md): Candidate model analysis, 33.5 MB budget math, Llama and GPT-NeoX topology notes, tokenizer constraints, and converter requirements.
- [GGUF MiRust All Source Review Bundle](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/gguf-mirust-all-source-review-bundle.txt): Large source review bundle containing the TinyRustLM source inventory, hot .uai memory files, docs, runtime, packer, harness, and model-breeding artifacts.
- [Memory Systems Domains Research](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/memory-systems-domains-research.md): Background research on AI memory domains, UAIX-style short-term handoff, long-term governed memory, and machine-readable knowledge routing.
- [Future-Proof Native HTML5 Techniques](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/future-proof-native-html5-techniques.md): Native HTML5, semantic structure, progressive enhancement, declarative shadow DOM, popovers, dialogs, and accessible no-framework web patterns.
- [Future-Proof JavaScript Without Dependencies](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/vanilla-js-future-proof-techniques.md): Native JavaScript standards, import maps, async control flow, reactive stores, navigation, view transitions, and security primitives.
- [Innovative Vanilla Web Design](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/innovative-vanilla-web-design.md): Advanced vanilla design ideas, view transitions, Web Components, Houdini, WebGPU, Web Audio, and immersive zero-dependency interaction patterns.
- [Agent-Native Vanilla Web Architecture](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/mememtech-vanilla-web-architecture.md): Agent-readable web architecture, semantic HTML, llms.txt, content negotiation, robots policy, and machine-readable site surfaces.
- [Analyzing Website Virality](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/docs/reports/analyzing-website-virality.md): Sharing psychology, growth loops, friction reduction, dark social, interactive microsites, and resilient infrastructure for public project sites.

## Machine Formats

- [Full text](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/llms-full.txt): Bundled Markdown content for agent readers.

- [Robots](https://TinyRustLM.mirust.com/robots.txt): Crawl policy.

## Boundaries

- This is a plain PHP site, not WordPress.
- Do not infer cloud inference or remote model execution.
- Do not infer trained assistant quality from runtime-smoke claims.
- Treat model and adapter licenses as artifact-specific.
- The contact page is for project and professional routing, not an automated support system.
- The former standalone runtime documentation lane is retired; use TinyRustLM.MiRust.com/developer-portal/ for current developer evidence.
- TinyRustLM.com is the current public app route; SLMComposer.com is no longer the canonical public app identity.
